questions.question: An association of two or more persons for a purpose of engaging in a profitable business.
A distinct legal entity which can practically transact any business transaction which a real person could do.
Double taxation is a disadvantage of which business organization?
Which is NOT a type of business organization?
What is the minimum number of incorporators required to organize a corporation?
In case of bankruptcy of a partnership,
choices: The partners are not liable for the liabilities of the partnership.
Only the partnership assets (excluding the partners’ personal assets) will be used to pay the liabilities.
The partners’ personal assets are attached to the debt of the partnership.
The partners may sell stock to generate additional capital.
questions.answerText: The partners’ personal assets are attached to the debt of the partnership.

questions.question: Which is TRUE about partnership?
choices: It will be dissolved if one of the partners ceases to be connected with the partnership.
It can be handed down from one generation of partners to another.
Its capitalization must be equal for each partner.
questions.answerText: It will be dissolved if one of the partners ceases to be connected with the partnership.

questions.question: Which is TRUE about a corporation?
choices: It is not the best form of business organization.
The minimum number of incorporators to start a corporation is three.
Its life is dependent on the lives of the incorporators.
The stockholders of the corporation are only liable to the extent of their investments.
questions.answerText: The stockholders of the corporation are only liable to the extent of their investments.
